name: Monoid
description: A set equipped with an associative binary operation possessing an identity element.

name: Group
description: A monoid in which every element is invertible.

name: Characteristic of a ring
description: The nonnegative generator of the kernel of the unique ring homomorphism Z -> A.

name: Opposite ring
description: For a ring A, the ring A^op with the same additive group but reversed multiplication a *' b = ba.

name: Left module / right module
description: A module where scalars act on the left (resp. right), with axiom (ab)x = a(bx) for left modules and x(ab) = (xa)b for right modules.

name: Basis of a module
description: A family of elements such that every element of the module can be written uniquely as a finite linear combination of them.

name: Rank of a linear map
description: The dimension of the image of a linear map between vector spaces.

name: Direct sum decomposition
description: A module M is a direct sum of submodules M_1,...,M_n if the canonical map M_1 + ... + M_n -> M is an isomorphism.

name: Noetherian module
description: A module satisfying the ascending chain condition on submodules, equivalently every submodule is finitely generated.

name: Artinian module
description: A module satisfying the descending chain condition on submodules.

name: Annihilator
description: For a submodule N of M, the ideal Ann(N) = {a in A : aN = 0}; dually for an ideal I, Ann_M(I) = {x in M : Ix = 0}.

name: Multilinear map
description: A map f: M_1 x ... x M_n -> N that is linear in each variable when the others are held fixed.

name: Right exactness of tensor product
description: The functor M tensor_A (-) is right exact: it preserves cokernels and direct sums but not injections in general.

name: Tensor algebra
description: The graded algebra T(M) = direct_sum_{n>=0} M^{tensor n} with concatenation multiplication, universal for linear maps from M to associative algebras.

name: Exterior product (wedge product)
description: The product in the exterior algebra, denoted x wedge y, satisfying x wedge x = 0 and x wedge y = -y wedge x.

name: Exterior power
description: The p-th component Lambda^p(M) of the exterior algebra, the quotient of M^{tensor p} by tensors with a repeated factor.

name: Symmetric algebra
description: The quotient S(M) = T(M)/<x tensor y - y tensor x>, a graded commutative algebra universal for linear maps from M to commutative algebras.

name: Symmetric power
description: The p-th component S^p(M) of the symmetric algebra, the quotient of M^{tensor p} by differences of permuted tensors.

name: Graded algebra
description: An algebra A with a direct sum decomposition A = direct_sum_{n>=0} A_n such that A_m * A_n subset A_{m+n}.

name: Extension of scalars
function_signature: (A-module M, ring hom A -> B) -> B-module M tensor_A B
description: Constructs a B-module from an A-module M and a ring homomorphism A -> B via the tensor product M tensor_A B.

name: Polynomial ring in several variables
description: The ring A[X_1,...,X_n] defined inductively as A[X_1,...,X_{n-1}][X_n], or as formal sums over multi-indices.

name: Euclidean division for polynomials
description: For f, g in K[X] with g nonzero and K a field, there exist unique q, r with f = qg + r and deg(r) < deg(g).

name: Root of a polynomial
description: An element alpha in an extension of the coefficient ring such that f(alpha) = 0.

name: Factor theorem
description: An element alpha is a root of f in K[X] if and only if (X - alpha) divides f.

name: Irreducible polynomial
description: A nonconstant polynomial that cannot be written as a product of two polynomials of lower degree.

name: Unique factorization in K[X]
description: The polynomial ring K[X] over a field K is a UFD: every nonconstant polynomial factors uniquely into irreducibles up to units.

name: Greatest common divisor of polynomials
description: The monic polynomial of greatest degree dividing two given polynomials, computable by the Euclidean algorithm.

name: Partial fraction decomposition
function_signature: (rational fraction in K(X)) -> polynomial + sum of a_ij/(X - alpha_i)^j
description: Expresses a rational fraction as a polynomial plus a sum of terms with prime-power denominators via the Chinese remainder theorem.

name: Algebraic element
description: An element alpha in L that is a root of some nonzero polynomial in K[X].

name: Transcendental element
description: An element alpha in L that is not algebraic over K.

name: Simple algebraic extension
description: An extension K(alpha)/K generated by a single algebraic element alpha, isomorphic to K[X]/(minimal polynomial of alpha).

name: Tower law (multiplicativity of degrees)
description: If K subset L subset M are field extensions, then [M:K] = [M:L]*[L:K].

name: Existence and uniqueness of algebraic closure
description: Every field admits an algebraic closure, and any two algebraic closures are isomorphic (though not canonically).

name: Separable polynomial
description: A polynomial whose roots in an algebraic closure are all distinct, equivalently gcd(f, f') = 1.

name: Inseparable extension / purely inseparable extension
description: An algebraic extension that is not separable; purely inseparable if every element has minimal polynomial X^{p^n} - a in characteristic p.

name: Perfect field
description: A field of characteristic 0, or of characteristic p in which the Frobenius endomorphism x -> x^p is surjective.

name: Normal extension
description: An algebraic extension L/K such that every irreducible polynomial in K[X] with a root in L splits completely in L.

name: Transcendence basis
description: A maximal algebraically independent subset of L over K, such that L is algebraic over K(B).

name: Norm and trace of a field extension
description: For a finite extension L/K and alpha in L, N_{L/K}(alpha) = det(mult. by alpha) and Tr_{L/K}(alpha) = trace(mult. by alpha) as K-linear endomorphisms.

name: Artin's theorem on characters
description: Distinct characters (homomorphisms) from a group to the multiplicative group of a field are linearly independent over that field.

name: Totally ordered group
description: A group equipped with a total order compatible with the group operation: x <= y implies xz <= yz and zx <= zy.

name: Archimedean ordered group
description: A totally ordered group in which for any positive a, b there exists n in Z with na > b, equivalently embeddable in (R,+).

name: Valuation (Krull valuation)
description: A map v: K* -> Gamma to a totally ordered abelian group satisfying v(xy) = v(x) + v(y) and v(x+y) >= min(v(x),v(y)).

name: Absolute value on a field
description: A map |*|: K -> R_{>=0} satisfying |x| = 0 iff x = 0, |xy| = |x||y|, and |x+y| <= |x|+|y|.

name: Convex subgroup
description: A subgroup H of a totally ordered group G such that if a <= x <= b with a,b in H then x in H.

name: Elementary divisors
description: The prime power factors in the primary decomposition of a finitely generated module over a PID, determining its isomorphism class.

name: Characteristic polynomial
description: For a matrix A or endomorphism u, the polynomial chi(X) = det(XI - A) whose roots are the eigenvalues with algebraic multiplicities.

name: Minimal polynomial of an endomorphism
description: The monic generator of the annihilator ideal of the K[X]-module defined by the endomorphism, dividing the characteristic polynomial.

name: Torsion submodule
description: For a module M over an integral domain A, the submodule Tors(M) = {m in M : am = 0 for some nonzero a in A}.

name: Torsion-free module
description: A module M over an integral domain such that Tors(M) = 0, i.e., am = 0 with a nonzero implies m = 0.

name: Semisimple module
description: A module that is a direct sum of simple modules, equivalently every submodule is a direct summand.

name: Semisimple ring
description: A ring that is semisimple as a module over itself, equivalently an Artinian ring with zero Jacobson radical.

name: Simple ring
description: A ring with no two-sided ideals other than 0 and itself (and with R^2 nonzero).

name: Symmetric bilinear form
description: A bilinear form Phi with Phi(x,y) = Phi(y,x) for all x,y.

name: Alternating bilinear form
description: A bilinear form Phi with Phi(x,x) = 0 for all x, hence Phi(x,y) = -Phi(y,x).

name: Sesquilinear form
description: A map Phi: M x M -> K that is linear in one variable and conjugate-linear with respect to an involution in the other.

name: Hermitian form
description: A sesquilinear form Phi satisfying Phi(y,x) = sigma(Phi(x,y)) where sigma is the given involution.

name: Non-degenerate form
description: A bilinear or quadratic form for which the canonical map M -> M* is injective, equivalently the radical is zero.

name: Radical of a form
description: The submodule rad(Phi) = {x in M : Phi(x,y) = 0 for all y in M}, the kernel of the map M -> M* induced by the form.

name: Orthogonal complement
description: For a subset S of M with bilinear form, the submodule S^perp = {y in M : Phi(x,y) = 0 for all x in S}.

name: Witt's theorem
description: An isometry between non-degenerate subspaces of a regular quadratic space extends to an isometry of the whole space.

name: Witt group
description: The group W(K) of isometry classes of non-degenerate quadratic forms over K modulo hyperbolic forms, with orthogonal sum.

name: Hyperbolic plane (quadratic forms)
description: A non-degenerate quadratic module of dimension 2 with basis {e,f} satisfying q(e) = q(f) = 0 and Phi(e,f) = 1.

name: Symplectic group
description: The group Sp(M,Phi) of linear maps preserving a non-degenerate alternating bilinear form.

name: Spin group
description: The double cover Spin(n) of SO(n) constructed inside the even part of the Clifford algebra, kernel of the spinor norm on the special Clifford group.

name: Spinor norm
description: A homomorphism from the orthogonal group to K*/K*^2 defined via the Clifford algebra, measuring the signed length of reflections composing an isometry.

name: Associative algebra
description: A ring A that is also a module over a commutative ring K, with K acting centrally: k(ab) = (ka)b = a(kb).

name: Lie subalgebra
description: A submodule of a Lie algebra closed under the Lie bracket.

name: Ideal of a Lie algebra
description: A Lie subalgebra h of g such that [g,h] subset h.

name: Commutator Lie algebra
description: For an associative algebra A, the Lie algebra A^- with bracket [a,b] = ab - ba.

name: Poincare-Birkhoff-Witt theorem
description: The canonical map g -> U(g) is injective, and ordered monomials of a basis form a basis of the universal enveloping algebra.

name: Free Lie algebra
description: The Lie algebra L(X) on a set X satisfying the universal property that every map X -> g extends uniquely to a homomorphism L(X) -> g.

name: Nilpotent Lie algebra
description: A Lie algebra whose lower central series g supset [g,g] supset [g,[g,g]] supset ... terminates at 0 in finitely many steps.

name: Solvable Lie algebra
description: A Lie algebra whose derived series g supset [g,g] supset [[g,g],[g,g]] supset ... terminates at 0 in finitely many steps.

name: Abelian Lie algebra
description: A Lie algebra in which [x,y] = 0 for all x,y.

name: Faithfully flat module
description: A flat A-module M such that M tensor_A N = 0 implies N = 0, equivalently M tensor_A (-) reflects exactness.

name: Faithfully flat descent
function_signature: (Module or algebra over A, faithfully flat A -> B) -> descended properties over A
description: Deduces properties of modules or algebras over A from their base change to a faithfully flat extension B.

name: Local-global principle
function_signature: (Property of module M) -> (Property holds iff it holds at all localizations M_p)
description: A property of modules holds globally iff it holds after localization at every prime ideal.

name: Support of a module
description: The set Supp(M) = {p in Spec(A) : M_p nonzero}, a closed subset of Spec(A) when M is finitely generated.

name: Associated graded ring/module
description: For a filtered ring A, the graded ring gr(A) = direct_sum_n A_n/A_{n+1}, capturing the leading term structure.

name: Filtered ring
description: A ring equipped with a decreasing sequence of ideals ... supset F_n supset F_{n+1} supset ... compatible with multiplication: F_m * F_n subset F_{m+n}.

name: I-adic filtration
description: The filtration of a ring A by powers of an ideal I: F_n = I^n.

name: I-adic topology
description: The linear topology on a ring or module defined by powers of an ideal I, where {I^n} forms a neighborhood base of 0.

name: Hilbert function / Hilbert-Samuel function
description: For a graded module M, H(n) = dim_k(M_n); for I-adic filtrations, H_I(n) = length(M/I^{n+1}M), both eventually polynomial.

name: Primary ideal
description: An ideal q such that if ab in q and a not in q then b^n in q for some n, equivalently A/q has every zero-divisor nilpotent.

name: Uniqueness theorems for primary decomposition
description: The associated primes and primary components for minimal primes are uniquely determined; embedded components may not be unique.

name: Integral element
description: An element b of a ring extension B supset A is integral over A if it satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in A.

name: Lying-over theorem
description: If A subset B is an integral extension, then for every prime ideal p of A there exists a prime ideal q of B with q intersect A = p.

name: Valuation ring
description: An integral domain A such that for every nonzero element x of its fraction field, either x in A or x^{-1} in A.

name: Place
description: An equivalence class of valuations on a field, or a homomorphism from a valuation ring to a field together with infinity.

name: Uniformizer
description: A generator of the maximal ideal of a DVR, equivalently an element of valuation 1.

name: Rank of a valuation
description: The Krull dimension of the associated valuation ring, equivalently the order type of convex subgroups of the value group.

name: Henselian ring
description: A local ring satisfying the conclusion of Hensel's lemma, equivalently every finite algebra over it is a product of local algebras.

name: Ramification index and residue degree
description: For a valued field extension L/K, e = [v(L*):v(K*)] and f = [kappa_L:kappa_K]; the fundamental inequality gives ef <= [L:K].

name: Extension of valuations
description: Every valuation on a field K extends to any algebraic extension L of K, with at most [L:K] extensions.

name: Principal divisor
description: The divisor div(f) associated to a nonzero element f of the fraction field, defined as sum_v v(f)*[v] over height-1 primes.

name: Factorial ring (UFD)
description: An integral domain with unique factorization into irreducibles; equivalently a Noetherian integrally closed domain with trivial divisor class group.

name: Invertible ideal
description: A fractional ideal I such that I*I^{-1} = A where I^{-1} = {x in K : xI subset A}; equivalently a locally principal fractional ideal.

name: Unique factorization of ideals in Dedekind domains
description: In a Dedekind domain, every nonzero ideal factors uniquely as a product of prime ideals.

name: Approximation theorem for valuations
description: Given finitely many independent valuations and target elements, one can find x simultaneously approximating each target.

name: System of parameters
description: In a Noetherian local ring of dimension d, a sequence of d elements whose generated ideal is m-primary.

name: Dimension theorem for Noetherian local rings
description: The Krull dimension equals the degree of the Hilbert-Samuel polynomial, equals the minimum number of generators of an m-primary ideal.

name: Dimension of polynomial rings
description: If A is a Noetherian ring, then dim(A[X]) = dim(A) + 1.

name: Catenary ring
description: A Noetherian ring in which all maximal chains of primes between any pair p subset q have the same length.

name: Universally catenary ring
description: A Noetherian ring A such that every finitely generated A-algebra is catenary.

name: Unmixedness theorem
description: In a Cohen-Macaulay ring, every ideal generated by height-many elements is unmixed (all associated primes are minimal of equal height).

name: Multiplicity of a local ring
description: The normalized leading coefficient of the Hilbert-Samuel polynomial, measuring algebraic multiplicity; equals 1 for regular local rings.

name: Coefficient field / coefficient ring
description: A subfield or complete DVR of a complete local ring mapping isomorphically to the residue field, guaranteed by the Cohen structure theorem.

name: Weierstrass division theorem
description: Division with remainder by a Weierstrass polynomial in k[[X_1,...,X_n]]: unique q and r with deg_{X_n}(r) < d.

name: Nagata ring (Japanese ring)
description: A Noetherian domain whose integral closure in any finite extension of its fraction field is a finite module.

name: Excellent ring
description: A universally catenary Noetherian ring with geometrically regular formal fibers and open regular locus; complete local rings are excellent.

name: Depth
description: The length of a maximal regular sequence in m on a finitely generated module over a Noetherian local ring, equivalently the smallest i with Ext^i(k,M) nonzero.

name: Regular sequence
description: A sequence x_1,...,x_n such that x_i is a non-zero-divisor on M/(x_1,...,x_{i-1})M for each i, and the quotient is nonzero.

name: Depth lemma
description: For a short exact sequence 0 -> M' -> M -> M'' -> 0, depth(M) >= min(depth(M'), depth(M'') + 1).

name: Injective hull (injective envelope)
description: The minimal injective module containing M as an essential submodule, unique up to isomorphism.

name: Matlis duality
description: Over a complete Noetherian local ring, Hom(-,E(k)) gives an anti-equivalence between finitely generated and Artinian modules.

name: Dualizing module (canonical module)
description: A finitely generated module over a Cohen-Macaulay local ring satisfying local duality via Ext and local cohomology.

name: Local duality theorem
description: For a complete Noetherian local ring of dimension d with dualizing module omega, H^i_m(M)^v isomorphic to Ext^{d-i}(M, omega).

name: Regular rings have finite global dimension
description: A Noetherian local ring is regular iff it has finite global dimension, and then gl.dim(A) = dim(A).

name: Bass's theorem
description: A Noetherian local ring is Gorenstein iff it has finite injective dimension, and then inj.dim(A) = dim(A).
